reason: I'd take the free first visit, but $13 a visit plus a sibling is real money on my budget, and I'd rather wait for a Groupon or a rainy-week emergency. I wouldn't pay for it in the first month.
objection: $13 a kid every time adds up fast, and it sounds a bit fancy for Salisbury. I can do the park or a free library thing for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or a deal around $8 a visit, or a free-trial pack of a few visits so I know my kid actually likes it.
